title: The Reunion
content:
The days passed by in the blink of an eye.

Every member of the family became busy with the wedding preparations.

Laughter echoed throughout the house.

Relatives arrived one after another.

Friends reunited after years.

Every corner of the house was filled with joy.

And before anyone realized it...

The day of Yashwanth and Varsha's wedding had finally arrived.

Although the wedding ceremony was to take place at night...

The celebrations had already begun.

Yashwanth couldn't stop smiling.

After everything he had gone through...

He was finally going to marry the woman he loved.

Meanwhile...

Siddu remained occupied with one responsibility after another.

Guests were welcomed.

Decorations were checked.

Every last-minute arrangement was carefully completed.

Watching everything come together...

A gentle smile appeared on his face.

"Finally..."

"Yashwanth's dream has come true."

"Once the wedding is over..."

"I'll return to France..."

"And continue the life I left behind."

For a brief moment...

He stood silently.

Then...

Another thought quietly entered his mind.

"Will Sneha come?"

"Where did she go that day?"

"Is everything alright?"

He gently shook his head.

"Don't overthink it."

"She'll come if she's meant to."

The sun slowly disappeared beyond the mountains.

Golden skies gradually surrendered to the soft colours of dusk.

Soon...

The moon rose gracefully, spreading its silver light across the evening.

Inside the house...

Yashwanth and Varsha were getting ready in their respective rooms.

Outside...

The wedding venue had come alive with music, laughter, and endless conversations.

Siddu continued helping Yashwanth's parents with the final arrangements.

Just then...

Shreya walked up to him.

"Siddu."

He looked at her.

"I'll take care of everything here."

"You should go near the refreshments."

"You've got something important to do there."

Siddu frowned slightly.

"Important?"

Shreya simply smiled.

"You'll understand."

Although confused...

He nodded and quietly walked toward the refreshment area.

The place was crowded.

Guests stood in small groups, laughing and talking.

Children ran around happily.

Soft music floated through the evening air.

Some people enjoyed their drinks while others shared old memories with friends.

Siddu looked around.

"Why did Shreya send me here?"

He couldn't find any work waiting for him.

After standing there for a few moments...

He smiled to himself.

"Maybe she just wanted to keep me away from the decorations for a while."

He slowly turned to leave.

But halfway through...

He stopped.

His eyes had fallen upon someone.

And suddenly...

The entire world around him grew silent.

The laughter...

The music...

The conversations...

Everything faded into the background.

All he could see...

Was her.

She stood quietly beneath the soft golden lights of the wedding venue.

The gentle evening breeze played with her hair.

Her eyes sparkled like stars beneath the moonlit sky.

Her face glowed with a beauty that seemed brighter than the moon itself.

For a moment...

She looked less like a person...

And more like a dream he had once believed he would never see again.

Time itself seemed to stand still.

His heartbeat echoed louder than the music surrounding him.

He had imagined this moment countless times.

Yet...

Reality was far more beautiful than any dream his heart had ever created.

Five years...

Five long years...

Had vanished in a single moment.

Standing before him...

More beautiful than any memory he had ever carried in his heart...

Was Sneha.

And for the very first time in five years...

Their eyes met once again.
